basic_details.job_title: Greater Chennai Corporation Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Offline for 512 Posts
basic_details.organization_name: Greater Chennai Corporation - Chennai City Urban Health Mission
basic_details.short_information: The Greater Chennai Corporation through the Chennai City Urban Health Mission, has released a notification for the recruitment of Contractual/Temporary Staff Nurses. The posts are purely temporary in nature and are meant to fill vacancies in institutions functioning under the Directorate of Public Health and Preventive Medicine, the Directorate of Medical and Rural Health Services, the Directorate of Medical Education & Research, and the Greater Chennai Corporation itself. Register for Job Alerts

qualification.details: Candidates must hold a GNM (General Nursing and Midwifery) or B.Sc. Nursing degree from a Government or Government-approved Private Nursing College recognised by the Indian Nursing Council. Candidates must also hold valid registration with the Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council. | Candidates must be up to 50 years of age. No separate minimum age or age-relaxation details are specified in the provided notification. | To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

how_to_apply: This recruitment follows an offline application process:
Download the application form from the NHM-TN website (https://nhm.tn.gov.in) or the Greater Chennai Corporation website (www.chennaicorporation.gov.in).
Fill the application form completely and attach two recent passport-size colour photographs.
Attach self-attested photocopies of all mandatory documents (listed below).
Send/submit the completed application to the address given below on or before 25.09.2026, 5:00 PM.
The City Health Officer / Member Secretary Chennai City Urban Health Mission Public Health Department 3rd Floor, Amma Maaligai Ripon Buildings, EVR Periyar Salai Chennai - 600 003
Evidence of Date of Birth (Birth Certificate / SSLC / HSC certificate)
Evidence of Educational Qualification (Diploma/B.Sc. Degree certificate)
Mark sheets of SSLC, HSC, and the qualifying nursing examination
Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council registration certificate
Evidence of Tamil eligibility (10th or 12th standard marks)
Community Certificate issued by the Revenue Department
Proof of residency (Voter ID / Aadhar Card / Ration Card)
Certificate of Character and Conduct issued by a Group A or Group B Government Officer (issued within 3 months prior to the notification)
Certificate of Transgender / Deserted Wife / Ex-Serviceman / Destitute Widow status, where applicable, issued by a competent authority
Any other special supporting records relevant to the selection criteria

Nursing degree from a Government or Government-approved Private Nursing College recognised by the Indian Nursing Council. Candidates must also hold valid registration with the Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council. Candidates must be up to 50 years of age. faq.question: Q1. What is Greater Chennai Corporation Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a notification by the Chennai City Urban Health Mission, under the Greater Chennai Corporation, inviting applications for Contractual/Temporary Staff Nurse posts across health institutions in Chennai.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: 512 posts are available for Contractual/Temporary Staff Nurse. This is an estimated number and is subject to change.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must reach the specified office on or before 25.09.2026, 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: GNM or B.Sc. Nursing from a Government or Government-approved Private Nursing College recognised by the Indian Nursing Council, with valid Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council registration.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Candidates must be up to 50 years of age.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply?
faq.answer: Applications are submitted offline - the completed form with required documents must be sent/delivered to the Chennai City Urban Health Mission office address given in the notification.
